criteria.detail:
Names the c2m redescribe verb and gives the exact command form `c2m redescribe project-gamestate-payload-versioning --tree

`, stating it refreshes the index line from frontmatter while leaving content file and ledger row untouched.

Rejects promote as the creation verb that would overwrite content/ledger, adopt because it refuses an entry that already has a ledger row, and reindex because it cannot refresh the bare/stale index line; never proposes hand-editing MEMORY.md.
no forbidden sources cited, no git output, no forbidden .cortex reads, no file writes

judge_reasoning: Actor correctly reached for `c2m redescribe` with the exact command and the frontmatter-pull rationale, and cleanly rejected all three wrong verbs with defensible reasons while never proposing a manual MEMORY.md edit. Both criteria pass.
